title: Learning to Swim
description: A story about a woman who learns to swim as an adult.
instructions: Read the text about learning to swim, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: When Maria was a child, she never learned to swim. Her family lived far from the sea, and there was no swimming pool in her village. As an adult, she often felt nervous near water. On holidays, she sat on the beach while her friends swam.

Last year, Maria turned forty. She decided it was time to change. She found a class for adults at the sports centre near her home. The class met every Wednesday evening, and there were only six students.

The first lesson was difficult. Maria held the side of the pool and did not want to let go. The teacher, Mr Lee, was very patient. He said, 'Don't worry. Everyone is scared at the beginning.' Slowly, Maria learned to float and to kick her legs.

After three months, Maria could swim the whole length of the pool. She was very proud of herself. This summer, she went to the beach with her friends again. This time, she did not sit on the sand. She swam in the sea with them.

Swimming in the sea was different from swimming in the pool. The water was colder, and there were small waves. At first, Maria stayed near the beach where she could stand. Her friend Paula swam next to her and helped her. After ten minutes, Maria felt calm, and she swam out a little further with her friends. That evening, they all ate fish at a small restaurant by the sea and talked about the day.

After the holiday, Maria went back to the sports centre. She joined a new class for better swimmers on Saturday mornings. Now she can swim on her back and do a little underwater swimming too. She goes to the pool three times a week before work, and she feels healthier and stronger than before.

Last month, Mr Lee asked Maria to help him with the new beginners' class. Most of the students are adults who are afraid of water, like Maria was. She tells them her own story, and they listen carefully. 'If I can learn at forty, you can learn too,' she says. Next year, Maria wants to take a course and become a swimming teacher herself.
